# Aditya Knox

> Aditya Knox is a remote YouTube Growth Specialist and Performance Marketing Manager with seven years of experience. Across all social platforms he has delivered 10B+ lifetime views and 100B+ impressions for 30+ brands and channels, grew one YouTube channel to 112.5M views in 16 months with $0 ad spend, and delivered 4.8X ROAS on paid campaigns. He is available now for full-time remote roles and agency retainers and is open to work globally.

Key facts:
- Roles: YouTube Growth Specialist (primary), Performance Marketing Manager
- Experience: seven years across YouTube growth, paid media and agency leadership
- Founder & Chief Marketing Officer, Improx Media International (LLC); Media Manager, ISKCON (Traveling Sankirtan Party channel)
- Client work across the USA, Canada, India, Dublin, Europe and South Asia; works US Eastern business hours
- Languages: English (advanced), Hindi (fluent), Odia (proficient)
- All figures come from YouTube Studio analytics or campaign reports. Revenue is YouTube's estimated figure, not a verified payout.
